content: This medication is part of a once-daily single-tablet regimen designed for the treatment of HIV infection. It contains a combination of bictegravir, emtricitabine, and tenofovir alafenamide (AF). Adding plans to your list allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs within the same therapeutic class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. By adding plans, you gain the ability to compare and evaluate formulary details. The information provided here is intended solely for general informational and educational purposes. It is important to note that individual plans may differ, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, you should contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
